name: Quietime
description_zh: Quietime 静夜工作室，摄影作品、影像与委托拍摄。
description_en: Quietime is a small photography studio. We make personal series, short films and commissioned work, and we take our time over them.
statement_zh: 在苏州拍人像，也去演唱会现场录整场。
statement_en: Portraits in Suzhou, and whole concerts filmed from the crowd.
copyright: Copyright © Quietime Photography. All rights reserved.
home_teaser_zh: 约拍，或者想用这里的照片和录像，都可以写信来。
home_teaser_en: For a shoot, or to use a photograph or a film from here, write to us.
about_intro_zh:
静夜工作室在苏州。

网站上的照片和演唱会录像，都是工作室自己拍的。照片多是人像，拍在旧园里、树林里和夜里；也有一卷是城市的天色。录像是火星演唱会的全程、直拍和双机位混剪。

约拍和作品授权，都可以写信来谈。
about_intro_en:
Quietime is a studio in Suzhou.

The photographs and concert films on this site were all made here. Most of the photographs are portraits, taken in an old garden, among trees and at night, and one roll is the city and its weather. The films are whole concerts, single camera close ups and two camera cuts.

Write to us about a shoot or about using the work.

services.text_en: In a place you already know.

services.text_zh: 同一个地方，不同时候的光线。
services.text_en: One place, in the light of different hours.

services.text_zh: 产品、团队和活动的照片与视频。
services.text_en: Photographs and video of products, teams and events.

services.text_zh: 作品授权、画册与展览合作。
services.text_en: Prints, books, exhibitions and image licensing.

contact_lede_zh: 告诉我们想拍什么、在哪里、大概什么时候。我们会在两天内回复，先聊想法，再谈方案。
contact_lede_en: Tell us what you have in mind, where, and roughly when. We reply within two days. We start with the idea and come to the plan after.

process.text_zh: 说说想拍什么，一起看参考，定下风格和地点。
process.text_en: Tell us what you want to shoot. We look at references together and settle the style and the place.

process.text_zh: 确认日期、时长、人数与交付内容，给出明确的报价。
process.text_en: Date, length, people and what you will receive, with a clear quote.

process.text_zh: 按约定的时间到场拍摄。
process.text_en: We arrive at the agreed time and shoot.

process.text_zh: 先发初选给你挑，再精修交付；胶片拍摄会附上扫描底片。
process.text_en: You choose from a first edit and we finish the ones you love. Film shoots come with the scanned negatives.

faq.q_en: When will the photographs be ready?
faq.a_zh: 数码拍摄一般在两周内交付精修；胶片需要冲扫，约三到四周。
faq.a_en: Digital work is usually delivered within two weeks. Film has to be developed and scanned, so allow three to four.

faq.a_zh: 可以。外地拍摄的交通与住宿另计，提前两周预约比较稳妥。
faq.a_en: Gladly. Travel and lodging are charged separately, and two weeks of notice makes everything easier.

faq.q_en: Can the photographs be used commercially?
faq.a_zh: 个人委托默认仅限个人使用；商业用途请在沟通时说明，我们会签署授权协议。
faq.a_en: Personal commissions are for personal use. If you need the pictures for commercial work, tell us early and we will put a licence in writing.

faq.q_en: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a_zh: 建议提前两到三周。节假日与黄金时段的档期紧张，越早越好。
faq.a_en: Two or three weeks is comfortable. Holidays and the golden hour go quickly, so earlier is better.
